body.en: How HBT80-16 Concrete Pump Orders Its Distance Cells Read each label with its own figure. Conveying Distance (Horizontal) is 120 m. Delivery Pipe Diameter 100 / 125 mm. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not read a metre figure off that frame. Neither cell is a metre. Only when the label itself puts them in that order. Theoretical Output is 50 m³/h.
body.zh: HBT80-16混凝土泵的距离格子按什么顺序印同一页如果同时有水平和垂直，两者不能对调；没有写出的垂直格也不能用别的型号去填。管路沿程要克服摩擦，水平段和垂直升高不是同一项工作。整机重量 6500 kg。理论输送量是50 m³/h，泵送压力是40 MPa。水平和垂直可以对调吗？米数只来自已经写出的目录格。Porsche F 218。

heading.en: Screw Fittings - equivalent length in meter

body.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the HBT80-16 Concrete Pump distance text in Xingtai as follows: Conveying Distance (Horizontal) is 120 m. Horizontal and vertical are not interchangeable when both appear, and a missing vertical cell is not filled from another model. A pipeline loses pressure to friction, so a horizontal run and a vertical rise are different duties. Total Weight 6500 kg. If a distance cell is missing on the HBT80-16 Concrete Pump sheet, it stays missing. Do not paste another manufacturer's boom length onto HBT80-16 Concrete Pump. Keep the listed order. Hebei Pinjin Machinery, Xingtai, Hebei, China
body.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把HBT80-16混凝土泵的距离文字写成：水平输送距离是120 m。画面「Diesel engine」的主体是Porsche F 218，不能代替这些格子。目录在同时写出两者时已经把它们分开。主体：Porsche F 218。这两格都不是米。只有标题本身写成那个顺序时才按那个顺序。输送量印在哪里？
